# Thisted

Thisted is a Danish municipality (kommune) that is part of Klynge VEST, one of the geographic health clusters participating in the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark) [^src1]. It is mentioned once in the corpus, in a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters that took part in the program's documentation of Indicator 8 (Structured Patient Education) [^src1]. No further details, relationships, or claims about Thisted are available in the source material.
